description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds; 0.17.8: giving the space back is re-asserted on every layout pass from the bar's own tree — the live pager is found from the bar and its bottom padding, and its pages', is taken again whenever Facebook settles it back — and the Reels page's own header hides too, on its own switch in Appearance, its height collapsed so reels get that space, back for three seconds on a touch) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + split the screen half and half when comments open, EXTENDED in 0.17.8 (the Hook diagnostics row proved the in-place controller path is never reached on the test phone — zero calls while real comments opened — so the half cap now also stands on the surfaces that phone can take: the regular comment sheet, its share capped where its parameters are built and its window height capped at both places the popover fragment settles it, the fixed eight-tenths box a full share falls back to included; and the video platform's split screen, its sheet height capped where it is handed to the sheet's component. The five split-screen launchers and the comment views setup only report that they ran, so the Hook diagnostics row — itself extended with the hunt's last-seen shares, ratio and heights — can say which surface a phone really opens comments through; on by default, settings > Comments). FITTED in 0.17.9: capping the sheet still left the video full-screen behind it, its lower half hidden under the sheet, so while a comment sheet is open the playing video's container is now settled into exactly the space the sheet leaves — the page's width, from the page's top down to the sheet's top edge — and the player re-fits the whole frame inside it, centred, as large as its aspect allows; closing the sheet gives the container back + tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance; 0.17.9: on the Reels tab the bar's fills are fully transparent and the opaque backgrounds of the pager, the Reels page and the bar's frame are cleared, while the reel's video container is lengthened to the bottom of the screen, so a reel runs to the bottom edge under the bar) + the Hook diagnostics row (settings > Pause, backup and diagnostics); quiet preset. FIXED in 0.17.10: the Hook diagnostics row on 0.17.9 proved both 0.17.9 mechanisms never once fired on the test phone, for landscape and portrait videos alike — the video fit's hunt never recorded a container, and the bottom clearing stood at 'not applied yet'. The hunt is rewritten: any video surface at least half the window's width and a twelfth of its height is a candidate now (the first shape demanded near half the window's height, which a 16:9 player — a strip a quarter of the window tall — can never meet), scored by the part of it on screen, walked as deep as the activity's content tree asks from the comment fragment's own activity (so Reels, Watch and feed players are all covered), and retried on the sheet window's own draws for about two seconds instead of three fixed delays; when it still does not land, the diagnostics row says how many tries it made, the largest surface it met and why it stopped. The bottom clearing now leaves its reason as its state at every way out (not the Reels tab, the switch off, no pager found), takes any kind of background rather than only a plain colour, adds the tab bar's ancestors on the way to the window, and the video's distance to the bottom of its page and of the window is measured on every Reels pass in either state of the bar, so the band's own numbers are always on the row.
